definitions.gloss: spurt; burst of speed near the finish
definitions.explanation: A deliberate acceleration in a race, especially in its closing stage. By extension, a final push of effort on any task with a deadline. From English "spurt."

examples.japanese: ラストスパート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: To put on a final spurt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残|のこ}り→残り：01622_nokori⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧スパート⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She put on a burst of speed with a hundred meters to go.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ラストスパート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: The deadline is close, so I'll make a final push this week and finish it.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ラストスパート: final spurt — by far the most common form
- スパート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put on a spurt
- ⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧スパート⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make one's move early
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧スパート: the closing burst

USAGE:
ラストスパート is used well beyond sports — for studying before exams, year-end sales pushes, or the last stretch of any project. Plain スパート on its own stays closer to racing.
